subject: Walmart Agent Gateway and Agent Profiles
headline: Walmart opens its store to AI agents

research.conclusion: Walmart is welcoming AI shopping agents while Amazon blocks them.

steps.title: Agent Gateway
steps.detail: A new MCP server lets approved agents search Walmart inventory and buy for users.

steps.title: Agent Profiles
steps.detail: Each agent gets its own profile and purchase history. Rolls out next month.

steps.title: Spending controls
steps.detail: Shoppers approve each purchase or set a spending limit.

steps.title: Agent terms
steps.detail: Returns still apply. Agents that break the terms get blocked.
